6/ The Elon Effect
Elon Musk has a history of boosting memecoins like $DOGE with a single tweet. His recent Doge-related tweets or actions can send ripples through the market, so keep an eye on him if you're trading memecoins.

1/ What Are Memecoins?
Memecoins are cryptocurrencies inspired by memes or internet culture. Think of Dogecoin ($DOGE) or Shiba Inu ($SHIB). They may look like jokes, but their communities have turned them into a serious part of the crypto world.
